title: City's Gastrosis
subtitle: Now I know why everyone's looking for a gastroenterologist.

trails.title: Trail ① The Proof of Human Eating Gold
trails.description: In a place full of gold bars, the noisy critter's relative, another critter has approached you. It is not hostile, and hopes to get your help.

items.text: City's Gastrosis

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: I am doing the weekly inventory check. I apologise for not welcoming you in time.

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: Umm, however, what happened to your outfit, my lady?

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: Look at the dust on your cheek, and where is the bow on your left arm? Why do you look like just crawled out of the trenches?

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: This ... is terribly bad manners. I hope that Mr. Forget Me Not and the high society you meet today will not think that the Sothebys are a group of savages.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Mr. Karson ...!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: You're all right. That's great!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: I haven't found you. And the servants are all ... Is there something wrong with our manor?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Did the Manus make any trouble?

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: The Manus? I don't understand, my lady.

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: I assure you that the manor has not been disturbed by anyone.

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: However, after dinner, all the servants somehow got acute gastrointestinal inflammation. Your favourite gardener, Nick, is in hospital now.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: What! How could that happen? ... And you ...

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: I was waiting for Master's phone call while they were having dinner.

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: Don't worry, my lady. I have double checked the food. I assume that it's just because of the inappropriate preservation.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Hah! If it's not those bad guys, the Manus, then I have nothing to worry about!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: That's it for now, Mr. Karson. I need to find the "Coco Carrot"!

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: "Coco Carrot"?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Yes, that remedy will save my friend's life! They are all waiting for me in the lobby. It's a close call!

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: ... I see. But please be at ease, and a decent meal will be prepared for your friends.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Thank you! My greatest Mr. Karson!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Where will the "Coco Banana" be stored?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Ohhh!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: ohh ... it hurts so much. How come there are so many green balls running around in the corridor!
Grrrrrr Meow!!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Grrrrrr Meow ...? Isn't it the Cactus Cat?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: You actually sneaked out while Anna was sick! So, did you come out to steal cactus juice again?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: I will get you drunk right now, or the manor will be messed up again!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Little devils, I gotcha! Ha ha, I'm quite good!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Huh? What's this little bottle next to the barrel? Manco ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Ah! Here is the magic "Mancozeb" that can cure all! The kind alchemist Sotheby will not give up any patients!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Thank you, alchemist Sotheby. Mr. APPLe has applied the medicine just now, and Miss Marian found the medicine outside the garden storeroom.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Ah ... there are still many arcanists who are better than me.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: But why do you look so serious? This is ...?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Come here, Miss Sotheby.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The Manus has taken action.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: There is a large scale disease outbreak in the city center. The news is on the radio.

items.speaker: Radio Host
items.text: According to the Public Health Service, by 8 p.m. today, 13,469 cases of asphyxiation deaths,

items.speaker: Radio Host
items.text: 2,283 confirmed cases of acute respiratory distress syndrome and 181,002 confirmed cases related to gastrointestinal inflammation were reported in 45 regions.

items.speaker: Radio Host
items.text: Patients with the new disease have had such primary symptoms as swallowing difficulties, shortness of breath, and gastrointestinal inflammation. The disease is likely to spread in the areas of residence where the patients live.

items.speaker: Radio Host
items.text: It has not yet been confirmed as highly infectious. PHS Commissioned Corps has intervened in food supply control and will report its findings as soon as possible.

items.speaker: Radio Host
items.text: The east side of Michigan Avenue in the Loup District, the Gold Coast block in the Near North Side, and the River North neighborhood are the most affected areas.

items.speaker: Radio Host
items.text: We have also received reports from Evanston and Oak Park.

items.speaker: Radio Host
items.text: Until the source of the disease is identified, we ask that general public refrain from eating at restaurants, cafes, bars and any public places. If not necessary, please do not visit major public hospitals in urban areas.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: More than 100,000 people are sick?! Oh my gosh.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: You look so angry, Miss Sonetto. Are you okay?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... I am fine. The casualties are staggering.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: How did the Manus do that? These are obviously exogenous diseases.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Could it be ... poison?!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Miss Singing Box said that people who are sick would all have stomach pains ... gastrointestinal inflammation, right?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: But even the hypertoxic ash of Peridexion Tree can't cause such a mass casualty ...

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: And this APPLe's symptom doesn't include gastrointestinal inflammation.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I have recorded the broadcast and ... the Timekeeper's situation, and will report it to the headquarters now.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Whether it is the solution to the "Storm", or the plan to rescue the Timekeeper, we all need the instructions at a higher level .

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: Apologies for interrupting.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Mr. Karson? Ha! Is it time for dinner?

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: Yes. Ladies and gentlemen, dinner is ready. Please follow me to the dining room.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: That's great. Thank you.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Do we have Haggis with plum sauce today? I want everyone to try the delicacy my father brought back from Scotland!

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: Of course my lady. Your favorite lekvar haggis will be served soon.

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: These dishes are made with the latest seasonal ingredients from the manor. May this wonderful night wash away our distinguished guests' weariness.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Mr. Karson?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: What ... what ... what are these?

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: These are the appetizers.

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: Or would you like me to introduce them, my lady?

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: The 1919 botrytised sweet wine,  Moulis en Medoc from Chateau Chasse-Spleen, Creamy Orange Caramels with Toffee Pudding, Puffapod in Herring Soup.

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: Cream of Watercress Soup, Oysters with Mignonette Sauce, and Dill Barometz.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: No. That's not what I mean ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Are you making a joke? But ... this is not who you are, Mr. Karson. ... I don't understand ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Huh ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: So ... is that ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: What do you say is in the bowl in front of you, Mr. Karson? What is it?

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: Cream of Watercress Soup made of wasabi, blue cheese, watercress, fresh shellfish.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Gosh! Mr. Karson, can't you ... can't you see it?!

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: If there is anything wrong with the cuisine, please let me know, my lady.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: I don't know what's wrong with you, Mr. Karson ... but these are not for dinner, not even food at all!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: These ... these ... are gold and money!!
TO BE CONTINUED…
